glosses: yard, court, courtyard (open area by a house or enclosed by houses)
court (residence and entourage of a nobleman)
farmyard (central area of a farm, excluding the fields)

examples.text: Mein Haus hat einen kleinen Hof.
examples.en: My house has a small yard.
We want to sell our farm.

examples.text: Die Toilette war draußen im Hof.
examples.en: The toilet was outside, in the yard.

examples.text: Die Kinder helfen auf dem Hof.
examples.en: The children help out on the farm.

examples.text: Warum hast du den Job auf dem Hof aufgegeben?
examples.en: Why did you leave your job on the farm?
